accepted.sourceIdentityEvidence: ČistéDřevo LA541 explicitly specifies natural beech plywood, 4 mm thick, length 50 cm and width 50 cm. The complete square and natural beech grain match the known ATEHNA beech variant. No supplier brand or unstated glue/core specification is added to the product.
accepted.nativeOriginEvidence: The earlier /big/ image route served only 1024 × 768. The untransformed /user/shop/orig/ upload is 1813 × 1723; the CDN and source website return identical bytes and SHA256. No resize, padding, crop, sharpening, colour or geometry change was made.

review.exactIdentity: Known beech 4 × 500 × 500 mm only; do not associate with unknown-species squares or different dimensions.
review.quality: Root independently approved complete square framing, natural grain, neutral background and no humans. Native pixel inspection shows fine low-contrast grain and veneer markings; subtly soft photographic texture is present without block artefacts or evidence of enlargement. All four sheet edges are visible. No edge thickness view is provided by this photograph.
review.accessories: One bare sheet; no accessories or extra units.

finalReview: Original supplier bytes were retained. No generated image, enlargement, padding, mirrored view or rotation was added. One beech main was approved here; two galvanized originals were approved and staged separately by root. Unresolved sources and their exact variant gaps remain explicit.
